title: Compare European descriptor bank zero Item information
changes: Add optional observed bank-zero field assertions to the recorded-scene differential harness.
validation: An isolated Windows build and one Wine raw-versus-e99 comparison passed for 800 Item-info frames, matching complete state, clock, video, OAM, dispatch and five audio outputs; protected inputs and frozen sources were unchanged.
limitations: Field 4 was not observed; both arms shared a native cache, and Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurements.
